title: Tenant attribute enrichment & safe-guarding at VPC/on-prem telemetry collectors
creator: Aisha Gomez
description: Add attribute enrichment, tenant-aware redaction, and context propagation checks at VPC/on-prem telemetry collectors to enable accurate per-customer tracing, metrics grouping, and safe routing into Redwood Hosted ingestion. This ticket covers the collector-side changes (agent/collector config, enrichers, adaptive sampling hooks), the ingestion pipeline compatibility knobs (metric label cardinality limits, trace tag whitelisting), and the observability surface changes needed to present latency and error dashboards grouped by customer/tenant for Dedicated and Private deployments.
acceptance_criteria: Collector can attach a tenant_id and deployment_tag to incoming traces/logs without modifying upstream apps
Collector enrichment supports configurable PII redaction rules and a whitelist for trace attributes
Telemetry pipeline rejects or maps high-cardinality attributes according to deployment config rather than failing ingestion
Per-tenant latency and error dashboards render within 30s of ingestion for Dedicated instances
End-to-end tests demonstrate trace continuity when requests traverse internal proxies and backends (no loss of trace_id or important attributes)
Security review completed and KMS/HSM key handling validated for attribute stamping in Private deployments
steps: Design: define minimal tenant attributes (tenant_id, org_hash, deployment_tag, environment, service_role)
Prototype: implement an enrichment filter in the on-prem collector (Go) that reads tenant mapping from local config or a secure sidecar endpoint
PII rules: add configurable redaction/regex rules and a whitelist for allowed trace tags
Sampling hooks: add adaptive sampling rule that prefers retaining traces for high-error tenants
Pipeline changes: add a label normalization step in ingestion to clamp cardinality and map unknown tenant attributes to '__unknown__'
Dashboards: add per-tenant views (latency p50/p95, error rate, request rate) and a top-attributes heatmap
E2E tests: run a simulated Dedicated deployment with 50 tenants and verify metrics/trace grouping and performance
Rollout: staged enablement (dev/staging -> canary -> full) with telemetry-based rollback criteria

2026-03-01 - PM feedback (Lina Ortega): Add an SLA story for per-tenant dashboard freshness; customers expect sub-minute visibility for latency spikes. Will add monitoring tests.

notes: Avoid adding tenant identifiers into raw payloads stored in long-term logs for Private deployments unless explicitly configured; prefer derived labels. Provide migration doc for customers that already embed tenant info in headers so we can dedupe attributes and prevent double-counting in metrics.
